narr: Thunderstorms produced locally heavy rain in southwestern New Jersey on the evening of September 10. Rainfall totals were as high as 3 to 5 inches.
ev: Several vehicles became trapped in flood waters in Brooklawn, necessitating a few water rescues.
A section of Knightsbridge Road in Eastampton Township was closed due to flooding.
Flooding occurred on the New Jersey Turnpike north of Interchange 4 in Mount Laurel Township. The flood waters had a significant impact on traffic flow through the area.
Widespread roadway flooding occurred in Mount Ephraim with some roads becoming impassable.
The northbound lanes of US Route 130 in Collingswood were closed due to flooding.
Sections of Interstate 295 become flooded and impassable from around Gibbstown to near National Park.
The Black Horse Pike in Runnemede was closed due to flooding.
